targets.label: S
targets.title: Euclidean generators, radial hermiticity
targets.statement: M'_pq=S_pq, D'=i S_{-1,0}, P'_p=S_{p,-1}+i S_{p0}, K'_p=S_{p,-1}-i S_{p0}; radial quantisation: M'^dag=M', D'^dag=-D', P'^dag=K', K'^dag=P'; [D',O']=(-i)(-i eps0 O'); level-one unitarity <s|K'_mu P'_nu|t> = 2<s|eps0+(-i)M'_munu|t> >= 0.
targets.project_object: restriction of the conjugation X->X^dagger of psl(4|4) to the conformal Killing fields (IP6); positivity of the tree inner product on level-one descendants and its one-loop correction (IP22).
targets.two_component: P_{alpha alphadot}=sigma^m_{alpha alphadot}P_m, K^{alphadot alpha}=sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha}K_m (Euclidean sigma); with IP6: (P_{alpha alphadot})^dagger = K^{alphadot alpha}.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Euclidean supercharges
targets.statement: Q'=(Q-i sigma0 S)/sqrt2, S'=(Q+i sigma0 S)/sqrt2 (Majorana basis, Lorentzian Q^dag=Q, S^dag=S); radially Q'^dag=S', S'^dag=Q'. Sec 5.2: Tr of p scalars, eps0=p, SU(4) (0,p,0), special short representation at the threshold.
targets.project_object: odd part of X->X^dagger: blocks (3,1)<->(1,3), (2,3)<->(3,2) of SW (17) (IP7).
targets.two_component: (Q^i_alpha)^dagger=S^alpha_i, (Qbar_{alphadot i})^dagger=Sbar^{alphadot i}; on parameters see IP7.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Bras by inversion; 2{S,Q}
targets.statement: bras = kets acted on by the inversion x->x/x^2 (M->M, H->-H, P->K); M^dag=M, P=K^dag, (Q)^dag=S, (Qbar)^dag=Sbar; 2{S,Q} = H - 2J_1 - 2 sum_{k=1}^{m-1} ((m-k)/m) R_k - (4-m) r/(2m) = Delta^[KMMR] >= 0; |psi> = Q (S/Delta0)|psi> + S (Q/Delta0)|psi>; Q~d, S~d*, harmonic states <-> Q-cohomology.
targets.project_object: dilatation part of [x1, x1^dagger] has one sign on all odd blocks (IP7); Hodge decomposition with tree + one-loop inner product (IP27).
targets.two_component: m=4, Q=Q^4_-: 2{Q,Q^dag}=E-2J-H1-H2-H3 (Cartan basis of [CY] (2.1)).

targets.label: S
targets.title: Lorentzian hermiticity and the conformal map to the radial frame
targets.statement: M_AB^dag=M_AB, (Q^i_alpha)^dag=Qbar_{i alphadot}, (S_i^alpha)^dag=Sbar^{i alphadot}; e^{-pi/2 M_0d}(.)e^{pi/2 M_0d}: iD->-H, P->E^+, K->E^-, E^{-r}=(E^{+r})^dag; Q^{+i}_alpha=(Q^i_alpha+sigma0 Sbar^i)/sqrt2, Q^{-alpha}_i=(S_i^alpha+Qbar_i sigmabar0)/sqrt2, (Q^{+i}_alpha)^dag=Q^{-beta}_i sigma0_{beta alphadot}; {Q^+,Q^-}=2 delta delta H+4 delta Mtilde-4 delta R; norm N positive definite (2.17); <0|Obar(0)O(x)|0> = I(x)/(x^2)^Delta, spinor I(x)=-i sigma^a x_a/(x^2)^{1/2} with N=sigma0, vector I=eta-2xx/x^2.
targets.project_object: conformal map generated by P and K relating a reflection-type real structure to the radial one (R5(a)); spinor inversion matrix in the field realisation of X->X^dagger on lambda (IP5).
targets.two_component: Euclidean spinor inversion matrix x_m sigma^m_{alpha alphadot}/|x|, inverse -x_m sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha}/|x| ((x.sigma)(x.sigmabar) = -x^2).

targets.label: S
targets.title: Field conjugation; reflection and inversion
targets.statement: O_E(t_E,x)^dag = Theta.O_E(-t_E,x); O(x)^dag = x^{-2 Delta} I(x)...I(x) O(x/x^2), I^mu_nu = delta - 2 x^mu x_nu/x^2; Q^dag = -Q^{II}; M^dag=-M, D^dag=D, P^dag=K ([SD] generators without i); <O|K_mu P_nu|O> = 2 Delta delta_munu <O|O>. [Ry]: N-S quantisation with K1+P1 (conjugate to D by a pi/2 rotation in SO(D+1,1)); SCT (3.35) + translation map N-S to radial foliation; reflection Theta: x1->-x1, [phi(x)]^dag=phi(Theta x) (3.37), Theta -> inversion R (3.40), [phi(x)]^dag = r^{-2 Delta} phi(Rx) (3.41), K=RPR, P=K^dag (3.43)-(3.45).
targets.project_object: R5(a) [I]: the hyperplane reflection is a linear isometry (commutes with H, K_t, P(eps,infty)); it exchanges S_+, S_-; composed with the antilinear real-slice conjugation (W<->W^*) it preserves S_+ (x) W + S_- (x) W^*, the action and the rotation-covariant I^CT[eps]; the radial conjugation is its conjugate by the conformal map [Ry] (3.35); its one-loop realisation is fixed by the reflection with P_1, K_1, D_1.
targets.two_component: [I] A_ij(x) -> |x|^{-2} A^ij(x/x^2); A_m(x) -> |x|^{-2}(delta_m^n - 2 x_m x^n/x^2) conj(A_n)(x/x^2); lambda_alpha^i(x) -> |x|^{-4} x_n sigma^n_{alpha alphadot} (conjugate dotted field)^{alphadot i}(x/x^2) up to a phase fixed by the real slice.

targets.label: D
targets.title: Inversion on the conformal Killing fields of the realisation
targets.source: derived; consistent with SD (112), Ry (3.43)-(3.45), Mi97 (2.24)-(2.27)
targets.statement: R(x)=x/(x,x): R_*(x->b) = (x,x)b-2(b,x)x; R_*((x,x)b-2(b,x)x)=b; R_*(E)=-E; R_*(rotation)=rotation. v -> -R_*(conj v) is an antilinear anti-automorphism of [v,v']=v(v')-v'(v), fixes Delta=2E, maps translation along b to special conformal along -conj b, rotation X_mn -> -conj X_mn. [x->v, (x,x)b-2(b,x)x] = -(b,v) Delta + rotation, so [P,P^dag] has dilatation part +|b|^2 Delta.
targets.project_object: even part of X->X^dagger on psl(4|4) of Chapter 2.
targets.two_component: b_{alpha alphadot}=sigma^m_{alpha alphadot} b_m; image parameter -conj(b_m) has sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha}(-conj b_m) = conj(b_{alpha alphadot}) (conj sigma^m_{alpha alphadot} = -sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha}); (P_{alpha alphadot})^dagger = K^{alphadot alpha}.

targets.label: D
targets.title: The conjugation on psl(4|4)
targets.source: derived from B04 (D.16)-(D.19), KMMR (3.1), DO02 (3.14), SD (112), manuscript prop:c2-special
targets.statement: In SW (17) blocks with a basis unitary for the compact Spin(4)xSU(4) Hermitian forms: X^dagger = diag(-1_2,1_2|1_4) conj(X)^T diag(-1_2,1_2|1_4). (a) antilinear, [X,Y}^dag=[Y^dag,X^dag}; (b) (2,1)<->(1,2), (3,1)<->(1,3), (2,3)<->(3,2), Delta^dag=Delta; (c) Delta-coefficient of [X,X^dag} for unit elements: -1/4 on the four odd blocks, +1/2 on (2,1), -1/2 on (1,2); (d) equals the supertranspose transport of the Beisert oscillator conjugation (A=(a,b^dag|c), A^dag=(a^dag,-b|c^dag)), st(D_B)=Delta/2; (e) diag(1_2,-1_2|1_4) and the identity violate the *-representation sign pattern; any block-diagonal Hermitian matrix with signature pattern (-|+|+) gives the same.
targets.project_object: the antilinear anti-automorphism of R5(a) in the realisation of Chapter 2 (with IP6 on the even part).
targets.two_component: xi -> xi^dagger in Sigma^*: eta^alpha_i = -conj(xi_alpha^i), etabar^{alphadot i} = conj(xibar_{alphadot i}), up to the outer automorphism (positive factor on S_+(x)W, S_-(x)W, inverse on S_-(x)W^*, S_+(x)W^*); fixed by Gamma(xi2^dag,xi1^dag)|_V = conj Gamma(xi1,xi2)|_V (product of factors = 1); (xi,xi^dag) = -sum|xi_alpha^i|^2 - sum|xibar_{alphadot i}|^2 < 0; labels (Q^i_alpha)^dag=S^alpha_i, (Qbar_{alphadot i})^dag=Sbar^{alphadot i}, (P_{alpha alphadot})^dag=K^{alphadot alpha}, Delta^dag=Delta, (r^k_i)^dag = conj(r^i_k).

targets.label: S
targets.title: Form of the one-loop two-point function; 20' and Konishi
targets.statement: mu^{-2 deltaD}<O(x1)O(x2)> = M0/|x12|^{2D0} + g^2 (M2 + M0 D2 log|mu x12|^{-2})/|x12|^{2D0}; 20': <Q_mn Q_pq> = 2(1-N^-2) eta eta (Delta12^2 + g^2 Htilde/4) + O(g^3), one-loop correction vanishes identically at eps->0 (related to vanishing beta); Konishi: ZK=(1+g^2 gamma xi0/(2 eps))K, <ZK ZK> = 12(1-N^-2)/|x|^4 (1 + 6 g^2 log|mu x|^-2), D = 2 + 6 g^2 = 2 + 3 g_YM^2 N/(4 pi^2), g^2=g_YM^2 N/(8 pi^2).
targets.scheme_independent: partial: D2 independent; M2 dependent (xi0 choice); vanishing of the 20' correction is a statement of this scheme (scheme-independent form IP13)
targets.project_object: tree inner product (M0), one-loop inner product (M2), separation dependence |x|^{-2(w_O+coefficient)} fixed by D_1 (ch06 cor:c6-dilcomp); M2 moves under finite parts of O(eps) (ch05 thm:c5-Oeps).
targets.two_component: 20' = 1/16 int omega (w1^ij A_ij, w2^kl A_kl) - 1/96 w1^ij w2_ij int omega (A^kl, A_kl); Konishi = 1/4 int omega (A^ij, A_ij); 6 g^2 = 3 g_YM^2 N/(4 pi^2) = -24 x unit.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Pairwise structure of the order-g^2 correction
targets.statement: <Tr(z1)^k(x) Tr(zbar1)^k(y)> = G^k P_{k,k,0}(N), G=1/(4 pi^2 (x-y)^2); two-particle interaction (f f + f f) B G^2, B=b0+b1 ln(x-y)^2 mu^2; self-energy delta N A G, A=a0+a1 ln; a_i, b_i gauge dependent; order g^2 total = (1/2) k N (B+2A) sum_perms Tr Tr; B+2A=0 by the k=2 theorem; sum_p [[T^a,T^p],T^p] = N T^a.
targets.regulator: unspecified (any regulator with the k=2 statement)
targets.scheme_independent: partial: ratio (order g^2)/(tree) for Tr X^k = (k/2) x (k=2 value) in every scheme with pairwise structure; vanishing needs IP13
targets.project_object: [I] for O = int omega tr((iota_w A)^k), (w,w)=0: one-loop/tree inner-product ratio = (k/2) x (k=2 ratio) when finite parts of O(eps) are pairwise (one-loop graphs with one O vertex meet two legs, ch05 lem:c5-cycle); gauge dependence cancels in B+2A.
targets.two_component: z1 <-> iota_w A = 1/4 w^ij A_ij, w^ij w_ij = 0; tr(iota_w A)^k = (-ig)^k (iota_w A^a)... tr(T^a1...T^ak).

targets.label: S
targets.title: A position-space scheme: propagator smoothing
targets.statement: Btilde(x,0) = -(1/4) Y^2 int d^4z (4 pi^2 x^2)^2/([4 pi^2((z-x)^2+eps^2)]^2 [4 pi^2(z^2+eps^2)]^2) = -Y^2 (log(x^2/eps^2)-1)/(32 pi^2), Y^2=2g^2, via 1/x^2 -> 1/(x^2+eps^2) (equivalent to differential regularisation; same in DR); A gauge dependent (xi-dependent, DR), B=-2A, gauge-dependent part prop. to 2A+B=0; <O_i Obar_j> = G^{2p+q}(F_ij + Btilde N G_ij); <Y_i Ybar_j> = C_i delta_ij (1+beta_i - Delta_1i log mu^2 x^2)/x^{2 Delta0}; beta_j depends on the renormalisation scale; diagonalise symmetric G w.r.t. symmetric positive definite F (eigenvalues of F^-1 G).
targets.regulator: position-space cutoff length eps on propagators (no DR in (13)); gauge dependence (31) in DR
targets.project_object: statement only: the fixed ratio of constant and log in (13), (33) is a property of the smoothing 1/x^2 -> 1/(x^2+eps^2) ((33) makes the constant vanish wherever the log does); in the UV-boundary minimal scheme the 20' constant is 27/2 + 4 log(3/2) with zero log coefficient, so the ratio does not hold there; after a field rescaling removing the 20' constant the trace part carries log|x|^2 + gamma_E - 3 log 2 against log(x^2/eps^2) - 1 in (13); no cross-check is drawn (revision 2026-10-29).
targets.two_component: z_i <-> iota_{w_i} A with null w_i; couplings from eq:c1-action with (X,Y)=2 hbar X^a Y^a.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Konishi normalisation is free; point splitting
targets.statement: K1|reg = a(g^2) sum_I :tr(e^{-2gc} phi_I^dag(x+eps/2) e^{2gc} phi^I(x-eps/2)):, a=1+g^2 a1+...; Konishi 'has no intrinsic normalization' unlike R-currents and stress tensor; Z=(mu^2 eps^2)^{-gamma/2}; a1=3N/(8 pi^2) gives <K1 K1> = 3(N^2-1)/((4 pi^2)^2 (x^2)^{2+gamma}), gamma1 = 3N/(4 pi^2); printed (27) log coefficient = 1/4 of the expansion of (24): the g of (27) is 2 g_std (footnote 3: the g of refs [6,7] is 2g), i.e. g^2 in (27) = 4 g_std^2; (45) tree orthogonality with N_i>0.
targets.regulator: point splitting of the composite operator, Fermi-Feynman gauge (position space)
targets.project_object: finite part of the Konishi O(eps) (ch05 thm:c5-Oeps trace part) can set the one-loop Konishi norm to 0; not available for 20' (IP13).
targets.two_component: Konishi = 1/4 int omega (A^ij, A_ij); gamma1 g^2 = -24 x unit.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Orthogonality of the Konishi and 20' descendants
targets.statement: (K_10*)_AB = 3 sqrt2 g t^{ijk}_AB tr(phi phi phi) + (6 g^2 N/(32 pi^2)) tr(psibar psibar) orthogonal to (E_10*)_AB = -tr(psibar psibar) + sqrt2 g t tr(phi phi phi): <delta^2 K1 delta^2 Q20'> = 0 requires the anomalous term; [EJSS]: <Obar20' O20'> = 1/(x^2)^2 + theta terms; D^2 O20'/6 = -(F6 - 4 B6)/2 unrenormalised in SSDR (g^2 w.r.t. F, D^2 O; g^4 w.r.t. B); <Obar_10/6 K_10/6> = 0; fn 13: whether classical field equations receive corrections 'may be a scheme-dependent property'.

targets.project_object: through one loop the inner product of the double xi-images of Konishi and of 20' vanishes (images from classical components and Q_1); bilinear coefficient = Konishi entry q1_targets T5; pairs a length-two with a length-three word (IP18).
targets.two_component: [I] tr psibar psibar <-> (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, eps^{alphadot betadot} lambdabar_{betadot j}) symmetrised in (ij) (10 of SU(4)); tr phi phi phi <-> (A_ik,[A^kl,A_lj]) projected to the 10.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Normalisation of protected operators fixed by symmetry
targets.eq: [AFGJ] (2.6)-(2.7), after (2.37), (4.15), intro; [BRvR] crossing relation p.2; [DFS] intro; [EHW] (45)-(48), conclusion; [HSW] abstract
targets.statement: <J_mu J_nu> = (1/(16 pi^4))(d d - delta d^2) b(g(1/x))/x^4; on the N=4 fixed line b is determined by the free-field content; primary central functions marginally constant; crossing v^2 G(u,v) - u^2 G(v,u) + 4(u^2-v^2) + 4(u-v)/a = 0, a = dim G/4; 2- and 3-point correlators of the stress-tensor/R-current multiplet satisfy nonrenormalisation theorems; [EHW]: A^q = g^-q A_q, d_tau<A...A> ~ int dmu <T A...A>, 2- and 3-point functions of analytic operators coupling-independent (assuming analyticity, no nilpotent invariants n<=4); [HSW]: energy-momentum multiplet coefficient fixed by anomaly considerations.
targets.regulator: non-perturbative (anomaly matching; harmonic-superspace Ward identities with assumptions; crossing)
targets.project_object: [I] R-current and T are Noether currents of S^(1)(x1) (x1 in so(W^perp), conformal Killing fields); their two-point coefficients are free; the 20' is joined to them by xi- and eta-components, so the one-loop 20' norm is fixed by Q_1, S_1 (and classical components) on the 20' multiplet; the field-counting functional of ch06 implements the [EHW] cancellation of explicit coupling powers.
targets.two_component: R-current from S^(1) with r = 1/4 R_IJ Sigmabar^J Sigma^I (dictionary generators-even); A^q with q letters iota_w A, each carrying -ig in A_I = -ig A^a_I T^a.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Separated points versus contact terms
targets.statement: W[J,Jbar] -> int d^4x1 d^4x2 d^4theta J F(g^2,N)/(x1-x2)^6 Jbar; 1/(x^2)^3 = (pi^{-2+eps}/64)(Gamma(-1-eps)/Gamma(3)) int d^np e^{-ipx}/(p^2)^{-1-eps}: F fixed by 1/eps poles, finite momentum terms are contact terms; order-g^4 corrections to <Tr Phi^3 Tr Phibar^3> vanish for all N; order g^2 by the stress-tensor-multiplet theorem.
targets.scheme_independent: partial: separated-point coefficient independent; contact terms dependent
targets.project_object: [I] the inner product is a separated-point quantity; terms polynomial in external momentum in the two-point function of O_1[infty], O_2[infty] are contact terms changed by finite counterterms of the pair of insertions; only the non-polynomial part enters R5(b),(c).
targets.two_component: Tr Phi^3 <-> int omega tr(iota_w A)^3, w null.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Quarter-BPS operators by tree-level orthogonality
targets.statement: 1/4-BPS operators defined to be orthogonal to all descendants with the same classical quantum numbers; Otilde = O - <O L_i^dag>_Born <L L^dag>^-1_Born,ij L_j; <Otilde L^dag>_Born = 0, <Otilde L^dag>_{g^2} = <Otilde' Otilde^dag>_{g^2} = 0.

targets.two_component: L_i contain Tr[z1,z2]..., z <-> iota_w A.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Mixing of dimension-four 20' operators; point splitting
targets.statement: tetrahedral point splitting (size eps); O_ren = lim a_l(g^2)/(eps^2)^{gamma/2} O_reg; a_l depends on the regularisation prescription; <O_i O_j> = 0 (i != j) at tree level and g^2; gamma1 = -<O_i O_i>|_{g^2, ln(x-y)^2}/<O_i O_i>|_0; finite corrections cancelled by choice of a_l1; one real solution.

targets.two_component: four-scalar words in iota_w A projected to the 20'.

targets.label: S
targets.title: Classical non-orthogonality and completeness of the basis
targets.statement: <O^J_{ij,m} Obar^J_{ij,n}> = delta_mn (1 + deltaDelta_n L)/|x|^{2J+4}, L = log(x Lambda)^-2, log Lambda^2 scheme-dependent constant (DRED: 1/eps + gamma + log pi + 2); torus: classical part M^1_mn non-diagonal; orthonormalising the classical part then diagonalising the quantum part orthogonally is incorrect unless double traces (overlap O(g2)) are included.
targets.project_object: the basis for tree orthonormalisation must be complete in all trace structures (general g in the project).
targets.two_component: Tr phi_i Z^p phi_j Z^{J-p}, Z, phi_i <-> iota_w A for mutually orthogonal w.

targets.label: D
targets.title: Order-g tree entries; the su(2|3) pair
targets.source: derived from B03 Sec. 2.1, (4.11)-(4.13); n4_untwisted D5
targets.statement: (i) a tree graph with one cubic vertex joining operators of L and L+1 letters sends one leg of the shorter and two of the longer operator into the vertex; (ii) for O1 = eps^{ab} Tr psi_a psi_b, O2 = eps^{abc} Tr phi_a phi_b phi_c: <O1|O2> = 0 at orders g^0 and g (remaining legs fermion vs scalar); (iii) B03 scalar product: <O1|O1>=4, <O2|O2>=18; B03 (4.13) with entry -9 sqrt2 e^{-i beta2} alpha1^3 g^3 is self-adjoint for these norms (real alpha1, beta2), printed entry not for beta2 notin pi Z; eigen-operators O1 + (sqrt2/3) e^{i beta2} alpha1 g O2 and O2 - (3/sqrt2) e^{-i beta2} alpha1 g O1 orthogonal at order g.
targets.scheme_independent: yes within the B03 frames with real beta2
targets.project_object: in su(2|3) the order-g length-changing terms are in the classical xi-, eta-components (cubic term of S^(1)(xi), prop:c7-susy) and in D_1, not in the tree inner product; independent confirmation of erratum D5.
targets.two_component: [I] su(2|3) letters phi_a, psi_alpha <-> scalar letters A_{a4} and undotted fermion letters for w = e_4 (q1_targets dictionary letters).

targets.label: D
targets.title: One-loop hermiticity identity
targets.statement: code names: G0 = tree Gram, G1 = one-loop Gram, M = G0^-1 G1, Y^adj = G0^-1 conj(Y)^T G0. Hermiticity <Xa|b> = <a|X^dag b> through order hbar <=> (X^dag)_0 = (X_0)^adj and (X^dag)_1 = (X_1)^adj + [(X^dag)_0, M]. Under a -> (1 + hbar Z) a: X_1 -> X_1 + [Z, X_0], M -> M - Z - Z^adj; identity covariant. S_1 = Q_1^adj + [S_0, M]; K_1 = P_1^adj + [K_0, M]; D_1 = D_1^adj + [D_0, M]; D_1 tree-self-adjoint iff [D_0, M] = 0.
targets.scheme_independent: yes (identity covariant under every change of operator basis)
targets.project_object: R5(c): <Q_1(a)|b>_tree - <a|S_1(b)>_tree = <a|{S^(1)(xi^dag), b}>_oneloop - <{S^(1)(xi), a}|b>_oneloop for all a, b, with xi^dag of IP7, one-loop inner product from two-point graphs (G1), Q_1, S_1 from the equivariant cochain; likewise (P_1,K_1), (D_1,D_1), (M_1,M_1), (R_1,R_1); finite parts of O(eps) act as Z; arity-0/1/2 finite counterterms and Q^GF choice act through the same covariance when they change O[infty] by local terms [I].

targets.statement: inner product <n1..nL'|m1..mL> = delta_LL' prod delta(n_i - m_i) (no cyclic sum); radial 'Hermitian conjugation simply interchanges creation and annihilation oscillators. For example, Q^dag = S, and D^dag = D'; D Hermitian => D_{2->L} = (D_{L->2})^dag; J_{L->L'}(g) = sum g^{L+L'+2l-2} J^(l); similarity J -> g^L J g^-L (same eigenvalues) gives J_{L->L'} = g^{2L'-2} J; scheme [D0, J(g)] = dim(J) J(g); L, Ldot, R uncorrected.
